notes: The report's own chain is the last one: Husayn b. Hurayth, Walid b. Muslim, al-Awza'i. Its saying is not in the packet text, which ends at al-Awza'i.
«وقد روي هذا الحديث عن الزهري عن علي بن الحسين عن ابن عباس» and «وروى الأوزاعي عن الزهري عن عبيد الله» name other chains for the same saying: two variant groups, never routes.
«رجال من الأنصار» is a group of unnamed men (rule 8), kept as written; «فذكر نحوه بمعناه» is a wording remark and is left out.
